fields.sentence: Sky-cats roost on the cliff-spires during the day.

q2_gaps: "during" + a day-part / time-of-day NP ("during the day") — During is specified only for nesting one eventuality inside another and is declared to be the head for those three words, while the day-part Time rule enumerates only morning/afternoon/evening/night under "in"/"at", so nothing legislates which head this phrase takes
review.notes: The postural-stative route (Experiencer subject + Location oblique, reified because the time modifier is a listed reification trigger) matches the perch/rest family of *Where a THING is*, and "on" is the event-side Location rather than an entity-attached On. The definite plural "the cliff-spires" correctly takes a GroupOf witness instead of Inheritance.

fields.sentence: Sky-cats do not enter the village.

review.notes: Matches the 'Owls don't migrate' and 'Coopers do not caulk the barrel' patterns: strength-0.0 distributing rule at confidence 0.9, definite object typed at top level, sky_cat genus emitted with the noun modifier left unexposed, and no QuantifierPhrase for plain 'do not'.

"The Keepers" is correctly the Name-only individual of the capitalized-plural-label rule (no GroupOf, no invented `keeper` typing), `sky_cat` gets its head genus with the noun modifier suppressed, the bare-plural kind-level object stays a bare filler, and the habitual takes no status atom. `tolerate` sits on the progressive-test boundary; Agent/Theme is defensible, with Experiencer/Stimulus the only alternative.
